value.rationale: The previously identified -1 threshold was explicitly conditional as a generic flip; this theorem proves all missing hypotheses uniformly in the natural entire memory-length and order domain, completely solves the natural primitive-two-cycle problem and quantifies its universal square-root opening. A higher-dimensional memory map can admit additional critical multipliers or subcritical onset, so excluding these with an exact positive spectral certificate and nonzero signed cubic is mathematically meaningful. The result does not claim global attracting basins or higher periods.
